answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by charging every new identity a non-refundable proof-of-stake that is held in a shared vault and slashed when its attestations grade as junk. Trust behaves like timber: it must grow ring by ring, season after season, and no shortcut yields structural strength overnight. A sybil operator must fund each clone at full price, watching that capital erode with every failed grade, while honest agents settle the karst of the ledger deep enough to stay established through every checkpoint.
